name: Tei-Untis
description: Tei-Untis was a planet inhabited by Zabraks that was located in the Tei-Untis system of the Core Worlds and the Interior. It was situated in grid square K-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A kleptocracy, it was governed by thieves. Some of the most skilled pickpockets in the galaxy were trained at the Tei-Untisian School of Ribbons.
